newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek cargo ship capsizes in storm, 20 missing.
newsitem.headline: Greek cargo ship capsizes in storm, 20 missing.

text.p: Greek rescue crews were searching for 20 people missing after a cargo ship capsized in bad weather, the merchant marine ministry said on Sunday.
"Passing ships, coastguard vessels, fishing boats and air force helicopters are searching the area for the 20 missing people, to this moment without success," the ministry said in a statement.
Only one crew member has been rescued. Another 17 seamen, two women and a child were aboard the Distos when it capsized late on Saturday off the port of Kimi on the island of Evia.
The rescued seaman told coastguard authorities he abandoned the Distos after two huge waves engulfed the ship. The coastguard spotted the capsized ship after he shot flares in the air.
The vessel, owned by the Heracles Cement company, was carrying 5,300 tonnes of cement from the central port town of Volos to the port of Piraeus, near Athens.
Many passenger vessels were advised to cancel their trips on Saturday due to storms in the Aegean Sea.
